szoveg_eredeti:
What makes an AI-generated world feel truly alive? For TaeWoo Kang, director and head of AIK Studio, it takes more than a compelling subject. From viral social videos to AI films for public agencies, his work brings entire worlds to life, where every detail matters.

In this episode of Creator Off Script, TaeWoo shares what stood out to him about Kling 4.0 and how cinematic visuals come together through the smallest details, lighting, and motion.
